description: FICTIONAL TEST BUSINESS: Northstar Learning runs in-person tutoring centres in Toronto and Vancouver, live online tutoring across Canada, a self-service learning subscription, and curriculum licensing for independent schools. Families pay for tutoring and subscriptions; schools buy annual licences. Workshop tickets are sold separately at both centres. Online and in-person tutoring share teaching staff, but software subscriptions and school licensing have different costs and sales cycles.
business_model: Tutoring fees, monthly software subscriptions, workshop tickets, and annual school curriculum licences
decision: Compare expanding physical capacity, online subscriptions, and school licensing without combining incompatible revenue units.
